description: Import up to 25 audio or video URLs in one call. Each URL is imported the same way as upload_and_analyze, and transcription starts for each one. At most 5 uploads run at once. Each URL may be a direct public file URL or a page link from a supported platform, which the server resolves to the underlying media. Supported page links: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, Reddit, SoundCloud, Twitch, Dailymotion, Streamable, Snapchat, Pinterest, Tumblr, Bilibili, VK, OK.ru and Rutube. Vimeo and Loom page links are not supported. Each accepted upload creates a media item and bills its duration against the workspace's minutes or credits. A failed URL does not stop the others, and the result lists every URL as uploaded (with its mediaId) or failed (with the reason). Returns once the uploads are accepted. Use get_media_status per mediaId, or list_media on the folder, to follow processing.

concurrency.description: How many uploads to start at once, 1 to 5. Defaults to 5. Drop it to 1 to import strictly in order.

folderId.description: Folder ID for every upload in the batch

mediaType.description: Applies to every URL in the batch. Send it only when the user has said which they want for all of them — "audio" if they asked for audio only, "video" if they called them videos. Otherwise omit it and the server decides per URL. Mixed batches: leave it off, or split into two calls.

sourceLanguage.description: BCP-47 language code applied to every upload, e.g. "en-US"

tags.description: Comma-separated tags applied to every upload

urls.description: The URLs to import, up to 25. Pass each one exactly as the user gave it; page links are resolved server-side. Exact duplicate URLs are sent once.

name: upload_and_analyze_batch

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Upload and Analyze Several URLs
